Welcome to Little Idly

We invite you to experience the soul of South India in Karama. Our artisanal vegetarian menu is crafted with the finest ingredients to deliver a warm, nostalgic, and professional dining experience.

Explore Our Menu
Our Heritage Story

Established in 2023, Little Idly was born from a passion for bringing authentic South Indian vegetarian flavors to Dubai. Located in the heart of Karama, we serve freshly prepared idlys, dosas, and traditional delicacies that celebrate the warmth of home-style cooking. With a focus on authenticity, affordability, and exceptional taste, we strive to make wholesome South Indian cuisine accessible to everyone.
